description: This file defines the ImageToolkitManager class, which manages image toolkit plugins within Drupal, including retrieving default toolkits, available toolkits, and supported extensions.

classes.name: ImageToolkitManager
classes.description: Manages image toolkit plugins, providing methods to get default toolkit, available toolkits, and supported extensions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImageToolkitManager with necessary dependencies and sets cache backend.

methods.name: getDefaultToolkitId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the default image toolkit, falling back to the first available if the configured one is unavailable.

methods.name: getDefaultToolkit
methods.description: Returns the default image toolkit instance or FALSE if unavailable.

methods.name: getAvailableToolkits
methods.description: Returns an array of available image toolkits, filtering out unavailable ones.

methods.name: getAllValidExtensions
methods.description: Static method that returns all valid extensions supported by the default image toolkit.
